vectors.description: PUBLISH_OK (REQUEST_OK alias, Type 0x07) with no parameters and empty Track Properties. A draft-20 subscriber that wants to change a subscription parameter sends a REQUEST_UPDATE after PUBLISH_OK
PUBLISH_OK with EXPIRES parameter (60000ms) — the one parameter whose draft-20 definition still names PUBLISH_OK (Section 10.2.16)

non-canonical PUBLISH_OK — the EXPIRES parameter type (0x08, the first parameter, so the delta is the absolute type) is encoded as a 2-byte varint (8008) instead of the canonical 1-byte form (08); decoders MUST accept

PUBLISH_OK carrying SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY (0x20), which no draft-20 PUBLISH_OK may carry. In draft-19 this parameter listed PUBLISH_OK among the messages it may appear in. In draft-20 it does not: subscription parameters travel on PUBLISH (initial values) and REQUEST_UPDATE (changes) instead. Section 10.2.1 requires an endpoint that receives a parameter in a message its definition does not name to close the session with a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION. EXPIRES (0x08) is the only parameter draft-20 still names PUBLISH_OK for.
vectors.error_detail: SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY (0x20) is not listed for PUBLISH_OK in draft-20
